title: 第17章 一夜苦修成功入门第18章 反手卖十两财源滚滚
content_zh:
;;
血液不断流下。
疤脸身体僵直，眼中带着不甘，直挺挺地倒了下去，了无声息。
林青喘着粗气，警惕观察片刻。
确认对方死透，这才上前摸索尸体。
从疤脸怀中，他摸出了一本薄薄的泛黄的册子，上面写着《断浪刀法》四个潦草的字。
随后，他又捡起了那把质地不错的横刀。
只不过林青翻遍他全身，除了几百个铜板，竟连一块碎银子都没有。
“亏大了！”
林青忍不住低声骂了一句。
想必这家伙也是穷疯了，才想着干这无本买卖，结果栽在了自己手上。
这疤脸实力不弱，起码也是炼皮后期武夫，若不然绝无可能抵抗这么久。
林青将秘籍和横刀用布包好，与采购的药材放在一起。
他看了一眼地上的尸体，费力地将其拖到一处隐蔽的灌木丛中，用枯枝落叶简单掩盖。
做完这一切，他不敢久留，辨认了一下方向，朝着清平县城快步走去。
夜幕降临，林青绕了些远路，才终于有惊无险地回到了济世堂的偏门。
他轻轻叩响门扉，里面传来姐姐林婉压低的询问声。
“是阿青吗？”
“是我，姐。”
林婉确认是他，门闩迅速拉开。

将他一把拉了进去，又飞快地关上门。
“阿青，你可算回来了，你去了哪里？”
林婉借着油灯光晕，上下打量着弟弟，见他身上衣衫都被划破，不由得惊呼起来。
“嗯，去了一趟山里，找到不少珍稀药材。”
林青回应。
“弟弟，为什么还要去那么危险的地方。”
“万一你出了事，该怎么办？”
林婉说着，眼眶忽然变得通红。
“姐，我没事，这衣服是被树枝划到的。”
林青连忙安慰自家姐姐。
几番好言劝慰下，林婉才平复了心情。
“我，我不是怪你。”
“我只是觉得，爹爹不在了，这家里的事都要你去操心和冒险，我却帮不上忙。”
林婉擦干净眼泪，认真说道。
“姐，说什么呢。我一个人还能把药铺开起来吗？”林青苦笑。
content_en:
;;
The blood keeps flowing.
Scarface's body stiffened, with unwillingness in his eyes, and he fell straight down, making no sound.
Lin Qing breathed heavily and watched carefully for a moment.
After confirming that the other party was completely dead, he stepped forward and groped for the body.
From Scarface's arms, he took out a thin yellowed book with four scrawled words on it: "The Technique of the Wave-breaking Knife".
Then, he picked up the horizontal knife with good quality.
However, Lin Qing searched all over his body and found not even a single piece of silver except for hundreds of copper plates.
"What a big loss!"
Lin Qing couldn't help but cursed in a low voice.
This guy must have been crazy because of his poverty, so he thought of doing this business without capital, but he ended up in trouble.
This Scarface is not weak, at least he is a martial artist in the late stage of leather refining. Otherwise, he would never have been able to resist for so long.
Lin Qing wrapped the secret book and Hengdao in cloth and put them together with the purchased medicinal materials.
He glanced at the body on the ground, then dragged it with difficulty to a hidden bush, and simply covered it with dead branches and leaves.
After doing all this, he didn't dare to stay long, identified the direction, and walked quickly towards Qingping County.
As night fell, Lin Qing took a long detour before finally returning to the side door of Jishi Hall without any danger.
He knocked on the door gently, and his sister Lin Wan's low-pitched questioning voice came from inside.
"Is it Ah Qing?"
"It's me, sister."
Lin Wan confirmed that it was him and quickly opened the door latch.
Pulling him in, he quickly closed the door.
"Aqing, you're back, where have you been?"
Lin Wan looked her brother up and down with the light of the oil lamp, and couldn't help but exclaimed when she saw that his clothes were all torn.
"Well, I went to the mountains and found a lot of rare medicinal materials."
Lin Qing responded.
"Brother, why do you have to go to such a dangerous place?"
"What if something happens to you?"
Lin Wan said, her eyes suddenly turned red.
"Sister, I'm fine. This dress was scratched by a branch."
Lin Qing quickly comforted her sister.
After several good words of comfort, Lin Wan calmed down.
"I, I don't blame you."
"I just feel that since dad is gone, you have to worry about and take risks in everything in this family, but I can't help."
Lin Wan wiped away her tears and said seriously.
"Sister, what are you talking about? Can I still open a medicine store by myself?" Lin Qing smiled bitterly.
